voiceover: Did Jesus rise from the dead? Everything in Christianity stands or falls on it, so this section examines it carefully. Here is what is inside. It starts with the facts even sceptical scholars grant, and asks what best explains them. You will find the case for the empty tomb, and for the appearances the first Christians reported. And the people who changed — frightened disciples, a persecutor named Paul, and James, Jesus's own sceptical brother. The question the whole section weighs — what best explains it all? Every one of these arguments gets a fully-cited deep-dive essay. Each claim is sourced, and the strongest objections are stated fairly, then answered. That is our standard — Checked Before Published. And you will not just read. On every essay an AI tutor answers your questions — ask it anything, or highlight a single sentence and ask about that exact line. Mastery mode lets you explain the argument back in your own words and have it graded. Daily practice brings the key points back just as you are about to forget them. There are pocket cards to share, and a Debate Arena to practise against an AI sceptic before the real conversation. Every essay comes in a plain-English version and a full deep dive, with read-aloud audio. History's own tools cannot compel faith, but they can weigh explanations — and the case here is that the best one is that he rose. Weigh it yourself. Start anywhere, and follow it where it leads.
